title: OpenFront Masters
html:
OpenFront Masters (OFM) was announced 07/07 2025 to be the official Tournament team.[1]


To be able to participate and interact you have to use discord, you can find the link in the official OpenFront.io discord.

OpenFront Masters intended use is to host events and competitions with a public leaderboard.


Outside of tournaments, there was a mention that it would be a place to support future beta testing and run community play tests.[2]


Rules and regulatory

In OpenFront Masters they use referees who are not allowed to participate in matches to stay impartial.

There are rules set up to prevent cheating, interfering and match fixing. To mention a few.
